fragile_framing: GEO experiment: Aggarwal et al. (KDD 2024) headline a gain of up to 40% in a position-adjusted word-count visibility metric. Treat it as fragile: the ICLR 2024 draft reported 37%, the paper's own five-seed rerun (appendix Table 6) gives 36.9%, and on Perplexity adding citations cut the judged score by 23% (19.0 vs 24.7) while keyword stuffing raised it 14%. It is not a citation, traffic or conversion gain.
